en.bdb: The duality scorches one and all

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੰਮਲ ਵਜੈ ਦੁਹੁ ਧਿਰੀ ਖਾਇ ਤਮਾਚੇ ਬੰਧਨਿ ਜੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: dha(n)mal vajai dhuh dhiree khai tamaache ba(n)dhan jaRiaa|

en.bdb: Two-faced drum roped all around is beaten from both the sides.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਜਨਿ ਰਾਗ ਰਬਾਬ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੰਨ ਮਰੋੜੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: vajan raag rabaab vich ka(n)n maroRee fir fir faRiaa|

en.bdb: Musical measures are played on rebeck but time and again its pegs are twisted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਨ ਮਜੀਰੇ ਟਕਰਾਂ ਸਿਰ ਤਨ ਭੰਨਿ ਮਰਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਧੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: khaan majeere Takaraa(n) sir tan bha(n)n maradhe kar dhaRiaa|

en.bdb: Cymbals being paired strike each other and smash their heads and bodies.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਲੀ ਵਜੈ ਵੰਝੁਲੀ ਦੇ ਸੂਲਾਕ ਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: khaalee vajai va(n)jhulee dhe soolaak na a(n)dhar vaRiaa|

en.bdb: The flute when empty from inside definitely chimes but when any other object enters into it (i.e. when duality enters it) an iron rod is pushed in it to clear it (it is put to trouble).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਕਲਸੁ ਸਵਾਰੀਐ ਭੰਨਾ ਘਟਾ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਘੜਿਆ।
verses.translit_en: suine kalas savaareeaai bha(n)naa ghaTaa na jaiee ghaRiaa|

en.bdb: The golden vessel is got repaired but broken mud-pitcher is not formed again.
Engrossed in duality the individual putrefies and is scorched for ever.
